messages.text: Williams leads Bears past Patriots in impressive victory

metadata.summary: Caleb Williams threw for 308 yards and two touchdowns as the Chicago Bears cooled off Drake Maye and the New England Patriots with a 30-24 victory at Soldier Field on Thursday night.
metadata.content: NFL: Caleb Williams and Luther Burden propel Chicago Bears over Drake Maye's New England Patriots | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content NFL: Caleb Williams and Luther Burden propel Chicago Bears over Drake Maye's New England Patriots Caleb Williams threw for 308 yards and two touchdowns to lead the Chicago Bears to another impressive victory, defeating Drake Maye’s New England Patriots; watch the 2026 NFL season live on Sky Sports, including every minute of the playoffs and Super Bowl LXI Friday 23 October 2026 07:38, UK Image: The Bears face Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks in their next game Caleb Williams threw for 308 yards and two touchdowns as the Chicago Bears cooled off Drake Maye and the New England Patriots with a 30-24 victory at Soldier Field on Thursday night. It was the second meeting between the young quarterbacks since they were part of the 2024 NFL draft. Maye, who was selected by New England at No 3, directed the Patriots to a 19-3 victory over Williams and the Bears when the longtime friends were rookies. But Williams, the No 1 overall pick, leaned on Luther Burden and Colston Loveland while outlasting Maye and the Patriots in the rematch. Williams connected on 22 of 33 passes in his second game back after being sidelined by a hamstring injury. Hamilton dropped out of the podium positions to sixth on worn tyres in the closing stages of the last race at Marina Bay after what proved the costly decision not to pit under the Virtual Safety Car, as the Ferrari pit wall had requested.
